title: Factorial
description:
Write a recursive function that calculates the factorial of a non-negative integer.

Factorial of n (written n!) is the product of all positive integers from 1 to n.

Example:
- Input: 5 → Output: 120 (5 × 4 × 3 × 2 × 1)
- Input: 0 → Output: 1
- Input: 1 → Output: 1
hints: Base case: factorial(0) and factorial(1) both return 1.
